identitySignals: Name matches exactly: 'High Performance Academy' (hpanation.com), the name used in the OUSD agenda
Based in Clovis, CA (primary headquarters with indoor soccer center), matching the agenda location 'Clovis, CA'
Website describes before/after-school and summer learning programs, matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' contract category
research.notes: No registry record (EIN, CA SOS, SAM.gov) was found, so legal name and organization type (nonprofit vs company) are unconfirmed. No Oakland mention on the site; identity rests on name, Clovis location and after-school program match. Contact page only offers a texting number and a form, so no phone, email or address given.

profile.summary: High Performance Academy (HPA) is an organization based in Clovis, California, founded in 2012. It runs soccer training, youth sports and enrichment programs, including before-school and after-school programs, summer learning and camps, at schools and sites across California.

review.notes: Name, Clovis CA base and before/after-school, summer and community-schools programs match the OUSD agenda record, so identity is plausible (no Oakland mention on the site, but the agenda location matches). The summary's 'at schools and sites across California' overstates the sources, which show only Central Valley sites (Madera, Fresno, Clovis), so the summary is flagged; website and headquarters are supported.
